summary: The Backrooms is a multiplayer survival RPG with persistent player progression across authored and simulation-built levels. Place sims assemble local layouts, populations and hazards around shared player, NPC, loot and combat systems; Level 11 is a modelled city with interactive street and subway fixtures, Sedco access, a skydeck elevator, and new model-based clothing support.
places: places/main (3D) - Level 0 / The Lobby, yellow maze and safe-room hub; authored fixtures, containers, shifting walls and hunters, with solo rooms by default.
places/level1, places/level2, places/level21 (3D) - Habitable Zone, Pipe Dreams and Locked; authored spaces plus Level 2.1 simulated rooms, zones, agents and set pieces.
places/level3, places/gamma (3D) - Electrical Station and Base Gamma; seeded layouts, hazards, agents, traders, generators and lifts; Gamma includes Marlo the smith.
places/level4, places/level5 (3D) - Abandoned Office and Terror Hotel; office structure/residents and hotel encounters, including Boiler Room Death Rat packs.
places/level6, places/level61 (3D) - Lights Out and Snackrooms; Level 6.1 food-court shops, service, vending and Camp Amber connect onward to Level 11.
places/level7 (3D) - ocean and room spaces; places/debug is a separate dark test atmosphere.

places/level11 (3D) - The Infinite City; generated city districts, subway and furnished Sedco Spotlight showroom with locked front door, street life, skydeck elevator, and an apartment lot off the alley west of the glass tower.
places/spamton (3D) - Separate dark wet-concrete basement showroom and animated boss arena; sim stages the room and boss, with its HUD mounted by scripts/ui.js.
roots: world.config.yaml - multiplayer entry at main; declares player actions, camera, player template and HUD, routing, and an eight-player cap; Backspace opens the main menu.
templates/player.js - ordered player behavior chain; locomotion/player precede swim, interactions and gameplay handlers, then spamton-fight, critter, main-menu and view3.
templates/camera.js + scripts/camera.js - camera entry; owns presented yaw/pitch and eye position; scripts/view3.js toggles player.state.tp.
places/<place>/config.yaml + sim.js + cells - place setup and placements; sims build local layouts and tick local behavior, generally sleeping when empty.
sim.js - world cadence and onOutOfBounds referee; players return true for normal respawn, creatures with state.home return home, others are destroyed for manager respawn.
places/level61/sim.js + scripts/lib/level61-extra.js - Level 6.1 assembler; lay() queues a versioned rebuild in pieces, then layExtra() adds mall, Camp Amber and staff pieces.
places/level11/sim.js + scripts/lib/level11-city.js + scripts/lib/level11-vaults.js - Level 11 assembler for model city, street and underground systems; incremental rebuild cursor is in place state.
places/spamton/sim.js + scripts/spamton-boss.js - dedicated arena entry; sim lays the basement and lights and manages boss presence; boss runs encounter and scripts/ui.js mounts arena HUD.
shared: scripts/humanoid-locomotion.js + scripts/lib/data/player.yml - shared avatar gait and heading for player and M.E.G. NPC chains; caches measured paces by model/scale; scripts/lib/body3.js supplies weapon animation and rowing.
scripts/lib/maze.js, level1.js, level2.js, level21.js through level7.js + data - per-level grids, zones, layouts and paths reused by simulations, geometry, labels and creature navigation.
scripts/lib/level-kit.js + scripts/lib/npc-respawn.js - named-person management, throttling and shared NPC return timing for place sims.

scripts/lib/clothes.js, scripts/lib/critter-model.js + critter/clothes/faces data - seeded coats, face traits and expressions plus rendered heads/bodies/garments; critter-model adds skinned head-covering mask children from garment rows.
scripts/lib/loot.js + scripts/lib/items.js + level data - shared item pools, rolls, remains, parsing and container helpers; art/props/build.py supplies modeled lockers/fridges.
scripts/lib/combat.js + scripts/lib/data/combat.yml + scripts/lib/ballistics.js - shared hit/armor and firearm accuracy/projectile rules used by player and NPC combat.

scripts/lib/condition.js + condition.yml, difficulty.yml and scripts/lib/stats.js - weapon/armor condition, balance multipliers and derived handling/carry values used by player, clothes, loot UI and NPC behavior.

scripts/lib/os.js + scripts/lib/data/os.yml + scripts/lib/fallout-hack.js - BackOS terminal content/commands and shared Science-lock hacking rules; CTRL/OPENS define panels used by scripts/os.js and scripts/os-ui.js.
notableExports: sim.js - cadence, tick, onOutOfBounds; places/level21/sim.js and places/level61/sim.js - cadence and tick; places/level11/sim.js - cadence, L11_FAR, l11Lean, tick; places/spamton/sim.js - cadence, tick.
scripts/ambient-anim.js - onSpawn, update; scripts/lib/ambient.js - fan, fanHousing, cable and DRIP, DUST, MIST, SPORES, BUBBLES, RIPPLE builders/effects.
scripts/lib/level21.js - grid, room, zone, exit and height queries/constants; scripts/lib/maze21path.js - canPass21, stepToward, cellNear.
scripts/l21-use.js - updateSchedule, ears, update; scripts/level21-geo.js - geometry; scripts/lib/chatter.js - tickChatter, CHATTER.

scripts/l61-use.js - MENUS, ears, landed, takeItem, vendExpire, ready, expire; scripts/lib/level61-extra.js - layExtra, faceling, person, PEOPLE, FACELING_IDS; scripts/lib/snacktray.js - tray constants and helpers.

scripts/level11-car.js and scripts/level11-boat.js - control/input/update; scripts/level11-use.js - ears; scripts/lib/level11-city.js - layCity, layStreet, tickCity; scripts/lib/level11-vaults.js - layVaults.

scripts/level11-elevator.js - updateSchedule, CAB_X/CAB_Z, Y_GROUND/Y_SKYDECK, callElevator, ears, update; scripts/level11-porsche.js - ears, ignite, control/input/collision/update; scripts/l11-gate.js - onSpawn, ears.

scripts/lib/os.js - CTRL, OPENS and shared BackOS content helpers; scripts/os.js - onInput, update; scripts/os-ui.js - osUi; scripts/lib/fallout-hack.js - calculateLikeness, initHacking, guessPassword, activateBracket.
ownership: scripts/player.js - persistent player.state progression, health/sanity, inventory/equipment/ammo/condition, needs, money, visits, combat/rewards, clothing, karma/rep and Level 11 l11Access; also transient movement/combat state.
scripts/stats.js + scripts/lib/stats.js - HALOGEN attributes, skills, points, tags and sheet state; initialize/migrate/spend points, derive carry/combat values and tick companion perks.
scripts/craft.js - craft actions, payout redemption and hunger/thirst drain; scripts/swim.js owns swimming/underwater/breath and swim session controls, timer and audio.

scripts/interact.js + scripts/lib/seat.js - player focus, loot and sit state; interact.js also assigns nearby containers to NPC owners, persists warn/anger consequences, handles vehicle entry/exit, and tracks the currently highlighted target.
scripts/talk.js owns dialogue/shop UI state and NPC rapport, gifts, trade and rep effects; scripts/lib/rep.js owns karma and per-group reputation calculation/writes.

scripts/meg-agent.js - NPC routines, attributes/nerve, loadout, combat, fear, cover, idle social coordination and transient movement/path recovery; interact.js writes NPC warned/angry memories for theft consequences.

scripts/lib/combat.js owns pure shared combat calculations; combat.yml is their tuning source; player.js applies hits while clothes.js/stats.js apply armor DR; scripts/lib/ballistics.js computes weapon spread and projectile paths.

scripts/os.js owns player.state.os terminal session and per-session panel done flags; it writes player.state.l11Access from panel grants (including sedcofront); scripts/level11-elevator.js owns cab travel session/display, schedule and calls.
flows: world.config.yaml actions → templates/player.js behavior order: locomotion/player, swim, interact/grab/rest/mahjong/talk/build/stats/craft/OS/lockpick/spamton-fight/horde, then critter, main-menu and view3; configured routing invokes scripts/routing.js.
world.config.yaml camera → scripts/camera.js; view3 writes player.state.tp/orbit → third-person camera; camera writes player.state.aimPt → player.js crosshair-aligned shots.

world.config.yaml Backspace → scripts/main-menu.js; menu actions and scripts/ui.js render menu/creator; creator C uses scripts/wardrobe-ui.js to emit dress actions → scripts/critter.js writes player look/outfits.
Spawn room selection → scripts/routing.js pickRoom: accepted ctx.requestedRoomId preserves invited/portal/party rooms; otherwise derives solo-<normalized userId or username> (guest fallback).
Engine out-of-bounds event → sim.js onOutOfBounds: player returns true for normal respawn; creature with state.home is repositioned there, otherwise destroyed for manager respawn.

Level threshold trigger → scripts/level-door.js maps pair IDs, writes arrival state.clipKind and calls companion.bring → nearby non-waiting followers cross; player.js consumes clipKind into state.xfer.kind.

Level 11 sim.js → scripts/lib/level11-city.js layCity/layStreet builds city and street from level11-models.yml and art/level11 uploaded model IDs; tick calls tickCity for billboards, parked cars and distant sirens; scripts/lib/level11-vaults.js builds the tiled subway with model turnstiles and girders.

Level 11 rebuild → place.state.lq holds cursor; ctx.session.l11q holds generated row list/keep set, spawns solids first in batches, then removes stale l11 roots before builtV advances; current sim rebuild version is V=33 and l11Lean applies distance visibility.

Level 11 BackOS terminal placements → scripts/computer.js / scripts/os.js session and scripts/os-ui.js screen; admin access uses CTRL panels and fallout-hack.js for Science locks; panel grant writes player.state.l11Access.

SEDCO-SEC-01 → scripts/lib/os.js OPENS maps Storefront doors > UNLOCK to grant sedcofront; scripts/os.js writes that key → l11-sedco-door uses scripts/l11-gate.js to slide open for authorized players.

Level 11 elevator cab/interior and landing call buttons → scripts/level11-elevator.js callElevator/update moves the physical cab between y=0.3 and y=35.7; Porsche interaction parents rider and emits press to its controller.

scripts/lib/data/clothes.yml hat row mask URL → scripts/lib/critter-model.js maskChild/seatMask attaches or updates a skinned mask and hides the covered head; scripts/critter.js uses this for player and local mirror. scripts/lib/data/shops.yml defines seven l11-tm-clerk stock rows.

scripts/interact.js focus changes or loot/sit/level exit → highlightClear for the previous local target; only the current valid focus gets highlightSet, and stale look rays are discarded after moving away.
behaviorFamilies: places/main/cells/* and places/level5/cells/* - authored fixtures with local sound/light state and red-zone variants; Level 5 carries portal/quest props and scripts/l5-rats.js runs Boiler Room nest/pack cycles.

places/level4/cells/x0z0.scene + Level 4 geometry/detail/prop/look and scripts/l4-office.js/l4-office-geo.js/l4-home.js - office plan, cubicle/phone/printer variants, resident schedules and home claims; Level 7 has its own ocean and room systems.

scripts/lib/l4-people.js + level4-people.yml and scripts/lib/l5-people.js + level5-people.yml - NPC roles, dialogue, looks and routines vary by person; meg-agent.js supplies combat and idle social behavior.
scripts/lib/craft.js + craft data - recipe category, costs, skill, bench, batch size and item family vary per recipe.

places/level21/sim.js + level21.yml + level21-geo.js - room blocks share generated hall/room structure; room type, zone height, lighting, decor and loot vary by authored grid data and deterministic hashes.

places/level61/sim.js + scripts/lib/level61-extra.js + l61-use/staff/diner/jukebox scripts - food-court venues share service systems with varying menus and Faceling roles; rebuilds queue solids first and remove stale roots incrementally.

scripts/lib/level11-city.js + scripts/lib/data/level11-models.yml + art/level11/build.py/street_kit.py - uploaded models furnish buildings, street, subway and Sedco; seeded kinds, colours and placements vary, with real taxi, payphone, food cart, newsboxes, trashcans, gondolas and store fixtures.

scripts/lib/data/clothes.yml + scripts/mat-cloth.js + scripts/lib/critter-model.js - garment rows select cloth patterns, printed textures and optional mask models; art/shop-masks/build.py builds the two skinned head covers.
migrationNotes: Level 2.1 grid is 30×30 at 4 m per cell (120 m square); keep level21.js passability/room zones, maze21path.js traversal, sim geometry/hound routing aligned, and roofAt in place state so ceiling checks survive ticks.

Keep paired arrival IDs aligned: Level 2 ↔ Level 2.1 (l2-from-l21/l21-from-l2), Level 6 ↔ Level 6.1 (l6-from-l61/l61-from-l6; wire trigger l6-wire-trip), and Level 6.1 ↔ Level 11 (l61-to-l11/l11-from-l61). Skydeck floor is y=35.7; elevator travel endpoints are y=0.3 and y=35.7.

Weapon condition is player.state.cnd_<weapon>; garment condition lives in player.state.look.cnd keyed by garment token and shared across same kind/colour copies; keep clothes.yml pattern IDs implemented by mat-cloth.js.

scripts/lib/data/combat.yml tunes scripts/lib/combat.js: armor uses DR reduced by penetration then DRe/(DRe + 0.5×damage + 8), capped at 80%; pellets are mitigated individually. Keep player hits, clothes/stats armor, and ballistics aligned.

Level 6.1 rebuild version is V=53: layStep queues spawn specs, prioritizes physics solids (including the floor on an empty build), replaces same IDs incrementally, then removes stale top-level l61- roots; builtV advances only when the queue is done.

Level 11 rebuild version is V=33: only cursor i lives in ctx.place.state.lq; generated rows/keep and version live in ctx.session.l11q. Preserve this split; the apartment is placed at x=-44.5, z=58 to keep its lot clear of the hero house and glass tower.
